theme: An open day with a short, overdue to-do list.
greeting: The calendar is nearly empty today, Dan — one birthday at five, otherwise wide open. What's pressing isn't meetings; it's a couple of bookings that have slipped past their dates.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A p1 in Todoist, overdue since Sep 14: reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week before holiday inventory in that market sells out.

needsAttention.title: Rebook the girls' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: A p1 in Todoist, overdue since Sep 21: now that you're back from the Sep 20 trip, reschedule the four kids' new-passport appointment.

schedule.title: Julia's birthday
schedule.detail: A birthday marked on your calendar.

flagged.title: Board-world connection request
flagged.detail: A NASBA Center for the Public Trust board member sent a LinkedIn invite to connect.

flagged.title: New Amazon sign-in from Florida
flagged.detail: An iPhone sign-in to your Amazon account this morning, located in Florida — expected if that was you.

flagged.title: Revolut card delivered
flagged.detail: Your new Revolut card ending 8674 has arrived and still needs activating.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail — cooking digests, furniture matches, book and garden promos.
inbox.clear: Nothing personal is sitting unanswered in the inbox.

recipe.title: White sweet potato soup with pickled scallions
recipe.why: An autumn soup that leans on the season's sweet potatoes and cool-weather alliums.

tasks.title: Call the dermatologist to book the appointment

acts.line: A clear calendar to open on — nothing holding the morning.
The afternoon stays open, room for the errands that have been waiting on a date.
Julia's birthday at 5 is the one fixed point on the day.
